semantics.source: Private editor binding prefers current last-saved project, else originally opened image. New/recovered-unsaved documents have no source. Save As changes the target without requiring revision change; export does not. Paths/capabilities are never returned by the registered status query.
semantics.authorization: Fresh source-bound read resource; only exactly the current canonical source accepted. Explicit discard_changes=true always required because history is replaced. AI separately chooses/grants source and consents to rebind current document context; metadata query grants no file access.
semantics.confirmation: Optional expected_revision rejects changes between inspection/dialog and request preparation; native confirmation always supplies its original revision and checks document/source. Prepared request/epoch/source and resource stamp rechecked at commit, including Save As without revision change.
semantics.success: Re-read current disk contents through existing decoder/project loader, commit prepared display atomically, clear undo/redo and set loaded state clean. Original source file is never written. Ruler/palette/export settings remain editor state; native canvas fits reloaded frame.
semantics.failure: Missing/corrupt/wrong-source/foreign-resource/extra-parameter/declined-discard, canceled/stale request, changed target/document/file stamp or display preparation failure preserve current truth/history.
semantics.recovery: Only the current editor checkpoint is removed on successful native or AI revert. Recovery metadata itself does not grant re-open authority; other editor checkpoints remain.
